title: Team Talk: Handling Requests at Work
instructions: 这是为A2水平成人学习者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方雅思测试，也不对应任何Band分数）。请先通读短文，理解团队如何比较处理请求的不同方式。然后完成8道阅读题（单选、填空、匹配、判断）。之后学习语法规则（have to / must / can；一般现在时与过去时对比），并完成8道语法题。最后进行口语和写作练习。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。
passage:
A. At a small company, four team members meet on Monday morning. They talk about work requests. A request is a job someone asks you to do. The team has many requests this week. They must decide who does what.  
B. “I have to finish the sales report today,” says Mia. “It is for the manager. I cannot help with other work this morning.” Tom says, “I must call three customers. They have questions about our new product. I can do that after lunch.”  
C. “Last week, we had a big problem,” says Leo. “We said ‘yes’ to every request. Then we were very busy. We did not finish our own work. We have to say ‘no’ sometimes. We must ask: Is this request important? Is it for today?”  
D. “I can make a simple plan,” says Mia. “We can write all requests on the board. Then we can see the busy times. We have to check the plan every morning. We must not forget it.”  
E. The team agrees. They write the requests on the board. They put the important jobs first. They finish the sales report and the customer calls. They also help one small request. At the end of the day, they are tired but happy. They have a good plan for Tuesday.

questions.prompt: What does Mia say they can write on the board?
questions.explanation: Mia说“We can write all requests on the board”，因此答案是all requests。
questions.evidence: “We can write all requests on the board.

questions.evidence: We have to check the plan every morning.

questions.explanation: 文中说“They put the important jobs first”，所以填first。

grammar.title: have to / must / can；一般现在时与过去时对比
grammar.explanation: 我们先看意思：have to 和 must 都表示“必须、不得不”，can 表示“能、可以”。have to 常强调外部要求（比如工作规定），must 常强调说话人认为很重要；can 表示能力或允许。再看时间：一般现在时表示现在的习惯或事实（We have to check the plan every morning.），一般过去时表示过去发生的事（Last week, we had a big problem.）。规则：have to 有人称变化（I have to, he has to）；must 和 can 没有人称变化（I must, he must; I can, he can）。否定：don’t have to = 不必；must not = 禁止；cannot = 不能。
grammar.example: We have to check the plan every morning.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about now.
options: She have to call the customer.
She has to call the customer.
She must to call the customer.
answers: She has to call the customer.
questions.explanation: have to 在第三人称单数用 has to；must 后不加 to；can 后动词用原形。因此选“She has to call the customer.”
questions.evidence: Tom says, “I must call three customers.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about last week.
options: Last week we have a big problem.
Last week we had a big problem.
Last week we has a big problem.
Last week we having a big problem.
answers: Last week we had a big problem.
questions.explanation: Last week 是过去时间，动词用过去式 had。因此选“Last week we had a big problem.”
questions.evidence: “Last week, we had a big problem,” says Leo.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about ability.
options: I can to make a plan.
questions.explanation: can 后接动词原形，不加 to，也不加 -s 或 -ing。因此选“I can make a plan.”
questions.evidence: “I can make a simple plan,” says Mia.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a rule.
options: We must not forget the plan.
We must not to forget the plan.
We don’t must forget the plan.
We must not forgetting the plan.
answers: We must not forget the plan.
questions.explanation: must not 后接动词原形，表示“禁止、不要”。因此选“We must not forget the plan.”

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a past habit.
options: Every morning we checked the plan.
Every morning we check the plan.
Every morning we checking the plan.
Every morning we checks the plan.
answers: Every morning we check the plan.
questions.explanation: Every morning 表示现在的习惯，用一般现在时；主语 we 用动词原形 check。因此选“Every morning we check the plan.”
questions.evidence: We have to check the plan every morning.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about permission.
options: You can to help with this request.
You can help with this request.
You can helps with this request.
You can helping with this request.
answers: You can help with this request.
questions.explanation: can 表示允许，后接动词原形 help。因此选“You can help with this request.”
questions.evidence: “We can write all requests on the board.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a past action.
questions.explanation: Yesterday 是过去时间，动词用过去式 called。因此选“Yesterday Tom called three customers.”
questions.evidence: Tom says, “I must call three customers.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about no obligation.
options: You don’t have to finish it today.
You don’t must finish it today.
You not have to finish it today.
You haven’t to finish it today.
answers: You don’t have to finish it today.
questions.explanation: don’t have to 表示“不必”，是 have to 的否定形式；must 的否定不用 don’t must。因此选“You don’t have to finish it today.”
questions.evidence: “I have to finish the sales report today,” says Mia.
